assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PNG sprite atlas for an Egyptian dungeon mobile RPG. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows equal square cells, square overall image. Transparent background, no checkerboard, no labels, no text, no gutters. Each ROW is one distinct front-facing Egyptian arched DOUBLE door skin, with FOUR opening frames left to right: fully closed, 30% open, 65% open, fully open revealing a dark doorway. Keep SAME doorframe position, identical scale and anchors across ALL cells, door occupies centered 65% width and 88% height with generous transparent padding; all details contained in cell. Frame and outer pillars stay absolutely stationary; only door leaves rotate inward. Dark opaque black doorway interior is intentional, outside arch truly transparent. Clean polished hand-painted cartoon fantasy, warm gold details, crisp silhouettes, restrained highlights. No characters, landscape, particles or UI. Row1: sandstone and amber-gold sun medallion. Row2: turquoise stone and gold scarab. Row3: dark red stone with bronze ankh. Row4: deep lapis blue with gold stars.
assets.cleanupPrompt: Edit this exact 4x4 transparent PNG sprite atlas. Preserve all door skins and the closed-to-open animation arrangement. CRITICAL cleanup: shrink and center EACH complete door within its own cell so there is at least 10% transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides of EACH of the 16 cells. No door crown or pedestal may touch any cell boundary. All doorframes within a row identical size and baseline. Remove all stray red/yellow pixels and all matte outlines; edges clean with true alpha transparency. Maintain 4 equal columns and4 equal rows square overall. No grid lines, no text. Keep dark opaque doorway interior, all outside-frame background transparent.
